name: pool-a-custom4
description: One remote memory pool for the four-endpoint custom fixtures (G5 fixtures 1-2, 4): 512 GiB, bank service 400 GB/s behind a 300 ns controller, attached to switch 4 over one 100 GB/s port. The bank rate is below the sum of the attachment links of four ranks so pool-overload is bank-bound.
